targets.outcome_quote:
Overall, the results of the current study support the ﬁndings obtained by Ali and Chamorro-Premuzic (2010) and
provide new information on the role of the dark triad and
intimacy on life satisfaction, increasing the explained variance by 11%.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict that the current study supports the original findings decides under rule 1. Specific differences in gender correlations do not displace the overall verdict.
